description: This file defines a background service for cleaning up old execution records within a control-plane component. It manages periodic cleanup tasks, handles configuration options, tracks metrics, and provides manual cleanup triggering.

classes.name: ExecutionCleanupService
classes.description: Manages background cleanup tasks for old execution data, including starting/stopping the cleanup loop, metrics collection, and manual cleanup triggers.

methods.name: NewExecutionCleanupService
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the cleanup service with specified storage provider and configuration.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins the background cleanup loop if not already running and if enabled in configuration.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the background cleanup loop if running.

methods.name: GetMetrics
methods.description: Returns current metrics related to cleanup operations such as total cleaned count and last cleanup time.

methods.name: cleanupLoop
methods.description: Internal goroutine function that runs periodic cleanup operations based on a ticker and context.

methods.name: performCleanup
methods.description: Executes the actual cleanup, removing stale and old executions based on configuration, in batches.

methods.name: ForceCleanup
methods.description: Performs an immediate, manual cleanup of old executions, useful for testing or manual intervention.
